propositions: verify_completion() and sign attestation read HEAD independently, allowing a concurrent commit to land between verify and sign, causing the close to succeed without a completion signature.
When HEAD drifts between verify and sign, rebar refuses to sign the stale tree but closes the ticket anyway, leaving it in a permanently closed but unsigned state with no non-force recovery path.
The suggested recovery ('re-close to certify') is a no-op because the ticket is already closed, and the only available recoveries are --force-close or manual fabrication of a manifest.
The default code path (no --ref argument) still reads HEAD twice and is susceptible to the race; the --ref workaround (from 80af) only fixed the explicit --ref path.
A benign TOCTOU race should either pin one revision for the entire verify+sign+close unit, or abort the close and leave the ticket in_progress to be retried.
